EU Nations Revive Rwanda Migrant Deportation Plans

Five European Union nations are reviving plans to deport rejected migrants to Rwanda. The scheme, which has been debated by Members of the European Parliament (MEPs), is seen by some in Europe as an ideal destination for such individuals. The reasons behind Rwanda's suitability for this purpose are being examined.
